one_liner: monday.com has a broad GraphQL API with self-serve OAuth apps, personal tokens, a free developer sandbox, and an official hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (a newer OAuth 2.1 flow with refresh tokens is also available) works for apps created in the Developer Center. Personal V2 API tokens are the simpler alternative. JWTs are only for verifying incoming webhooks, so they are not a client auth method.
access_notes: A free developer account gives an API token and up to 10 seats. API access is included on all plans. The Free plan has a 200 call/day limit, and the developer account has higher limits.
blocker_notes: None. Credentials are self-serve and free through the developer account.
